newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 18.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
China's automobile production hit over 1.2 million units in January-October, a rise of 2.42 percent compared with the same 1995 period.
The Ministry of Internal Trade will pass measures to regulate China's chain store business in a bid to boost retail trade.
China has 44 joint venture colour television producers that have an annual production capacity of 24 million sets a year against domestic demand of 18 million sets.
The central bank says China's December interest rate subsidy will be 3.72 percent.

Average monthly increase of bank deposits fell to 54.2 billion yuan in the third quarter compared with 119.65 billion yuan in the first quarter after the central bank cut interest rates twice this year.
Minister of Construction Hou Jie says commercial housing prices could be slashed by 20 to 30 percent.
